text: ['Beautiful spot right by the beach in St Heliers. Love coming here for brunch, but dinner was a whole new level – fresh tiger prawns, perfectly cooked eye fillet and market fish, and the most amazing light tiramisu with strawberry sauce. Great food, romantic atmosphere, and stunning sea views!', 'Our lunch at La Vista Cafe was OMG delicious. The reviews are very complimentary about the cafe and I 💯 % agree. We had Tapas to include smoked fish cakes, patatas bravas, lamb and chorizio dumplings, albondigas and pizza focaccia. I actually like all the nice lighting arrangements!', "100% recommend this wonderful café! Here I say it - this is the best place in St.Helliers and the Mission Bay area ❤️❤️❤️", 'Always a great experience at La Vista. Highly recommend the breakfasts, tapas, fries, and sticky date pudding. My wife had the lamb burger lunch deal with drinks. Both meals were excellent with my Huevos rancheros the best I have had in years. It was served in a generous pot, steaming hot and delicious. The accompanying coffee was perfect. The restaurant atmosphere was perfect for a Spanish eatery and was very comfortable. The eatery looks out onto St Heliers Bay with the view sometimes blocked by buses. Staff are very pleasant and helpful. Will be returning to try other menu items.', "I had a good time at here and lovely to had lunch at this beautiful place. I feel energetic for my work. Only downside was the tables are very close - so the conversation of you and your neighbours are not private…', 'La Vista is such a lovely spot with amazing food and a beautiful sea view. We ordered the pork ribs as a starter and they were perfectly grilled and flavorful. The highlight for me was the Paella Del Oceano, packed with fresh seafood and full of flavor. The Beef Wellington was also outstanding – tender, juicy, and cooked to perfection. 👍 We finished with a warm sticky date pudding that was just the right amount of sweet. Great service, cozy atmosphere, and definitely worth visiting!❤️', 'We ordered My Breakfast and Aussie Breakfast and they taste really good. Service and location were great. Will definitely visit again.']

text: ['Hey everyone! I just wanted to share my experience at this amazing Mediterranean restaurant in Auckland. The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was top-notch. The staff was friendly and welcoming, and they made sure we had a great time. The prices were also very reasonable, so you can get a great meal without breaking the bank. I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone who’s looking for a tasty and memorable dining experience. It’s definitely a place that you can take your friends or family to, and it’s sure to impress. I can’t wait to go back again soon! Cheers!', 'We’ve been wanting to try Mediterranean food for quite some time and was browsing through goggle review and found this place. It was a good experience as the food we have had was excellent. Lunch plate chicken was good specifically the chicken itself. And Lahmajun we did not expect much initially but it has a pretty unique flavor. For the Turkish coffee and Turkish Delight , I didn’t enjoy it particularly as I feel like the coffee taste as normal black coffee.', 'Had a really nice time here. The atmosphere was relaxed and welcoming, and the staff were attentive without being overbearing. You can tell they care about the details—everything from the way the dishes are plated to how smoothly things run. The food had a lot of flavor without trying too hard, and I appreciated the balance in the menu. Would definitely come back if I’m in the area again.', 'I ordered the Cherkez chicken — it was beautifully roasted with a delicious charred flavour. The salad was well-seasoned and added just the right acidity to balance the meal. The creamy walnut tarator was absolutely to die for and truly elevated the dish. This restaurant is popular for large group celebrations. They served our group well, though it did get a bit chaotic during payment, so I recommend organising a group list in advance to avoid anyone being overcharged.', 'Thank you team at Casablanca Sylvia park for making my mum’s mother’s days so special. Food was delicious and amazing. Special thanks to the head chef Arunesh, the store manager and the beautiful waitress for the amazing service. Will surely be back.', 'We had an absolutely wonderful dining experience at this Mediterranean restaurant. From the moment we walked in, we were greeted with warm hospitality and a welcoming atmosphere that set the tone for the evening. The food was outstanding—fresh, flavorful, and beautifully presented. The platter was a highlight, offering a delicious variety of textures and tastes to share. The prawns and calamari were cooked to perfection—tender, juicy, and bursting with authentic Mediterranean flavors. The service was attentive without being intrusive, and the staff had great knowledge of the menu, offering helpful recommendations for both food and beer. The ambiance was cozy, making it a perfect spot for both casual dinners and special occasions. We also loved the thoughtful touches, like freshly baked bread and house-made dips, which made the meal feel extra special. Overall, this restaurant is a gem—authentic, high-quality Mediterranean cuisine paired with excellent service. We’ll definitely be coming back and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a memorable dining experience.', "Excellent Mediterranean restaurant in Sylvia Park. Breakfast, Lunch or Dinner. There's something to sample all day. I ordered an Express Lunch with Chicken and the portion was just right. The food came out fast and the service was awesome too", 'The food was so delicious, but I think it is overpriced - just slightly. We spent $54 for two meals, no drinks. The eggs in my shakshuka was also over-cooked and rubbery, sadly. Other than that, the food was really good! Great vegetarian options too.', 'Nice place, plenty of seating and space. We ordered eggs benedict, one with halloumi and one with mushrooms. Loved the decor. Staff were pleasant but quiet and vibe would have better with some background music.']

address: Sylvia Park Shopping Centre 66 Dining Lane, Mount Wellington Highway, Mount Wellington, Auckland 1060, New Zealand

text: ['My partner and I visited Jervois Steakhouse on a busy Friday around 1:45pm—and from the moment we walked in, we knew we were in good hands. The ambience is warm and inviting with classic steakhouse charm—leather chairs, rich brown tones, curated art, and a glowing fireplace that adds just the right touch of comfort to the upstairs space. Now let’s cut to the chase—the steaks? Absolutely divine. Absolutely worth the price. We shared the mighty 800g T-Bone and a perfectly marbled Scotch Steak. Both were cooked to perfection and packed with deep, satisfying flavor. The hollandaise and mushroom sauces were the clear standouts—rich, velvety, and the perfect complement to the steaks. But the real surprise? The Wagyu fat roasted kumara. Sweet, smoky, and finished with whiskey caramel, pecan, and feta—it stole the show. Honestly, it might be one of the best sides I’ve ever had. The potato gratin and seasonal greens were also excellent, but that kumara… unforgettable. We paired everything with a couple of bold reds that brought it all together. Dessert was a crème brûlée and a classic affogato—simple, satisfying, and just the right finish. Service was outstanding—genuinely warm, knowledgeable, and perfectly timed despite the lunch rush. Our waiter went above and beyond to make sure that we were comfortable. His recommendations were also excellent! In short: top-tier food, flawless service, and an atmosphere that feels effortlessly polished. We left full, happy, and already planning our return.', 'Would strongly recommend this place to anyone looking for some delicious steak, everything they presented was amazing. The fish grills, sides, starters and the drinks. Top Notch! Definitely coming back for more, loved the service by Alex, made us so comfortable for the evening. The manager Bevin was also very welcoming, overall service was splendid!!', 'This is the best steakhouse I’ve ever visited fantastic atmosphere and perfectly cooked steaks. I had the rib eye and the wagyu scotch fillet, both incredible. Even the entrées and sides were delicious. The service was outstanding; the staff clearly know their craft. I’ll definitely be returning.', "Experience from start to finish has been absolutely great. Special thanks to Julia, the hostess, for keeping the kitchen's last order open for us until we arrived. Julia is very social and friendly and makes you feel welcomed at the restaurant. The ambience and environment of the restaurant are amazing. Service was outstanding, amazing explanation about meat selection and side, and desert selection Serious compliments to the chef and the staff. It's absolutely amazing. I'm definitely returning. 💯", 'The ambiance is so cosy, the staff are warm and nice, and the food is amazing, I have ordered an entree (scallops) and a T-bone steak, so good', 'Love the atmosphere. Even though we had to wait over 30 minutes for our meals, it was definitely worth the wait. Every steaks were cooked to perfection.', 'Super nice steak if you want to treat yourself. I found the service was a bit slow but the food was top notch. They show you the cuts before you order which is really handy as if you are not an officialdo then it is not clear what you are going to get. Order you mains, sauce and then side. You are talking about $100-$150 per person by the time you include drinks and sides. The meat was super tender and glad we came. We went on a Thursday and it was busy, with people sitting outside. Well worth a visit and the food quality of food is excellent.']

text: ['Vietnamese fusion restaurant. The window seats with a view of Galway Street create a nice atmosphere, with paper lanterns hanging from the ceiling. The service was friendly and professional. I would recommend the kingfish crudo and tiger prawn entrée. However, I found the main dish a bit disappointing. The pork belly reminded me of Hong shao rou from Chinese restaurants, but it didn’t have much depth of flavour and was quite sweet. The soft shell crab salad was also served in a sweet sauce, which might not be appealing to those who aren’t fans of soggy fried food. On a positive note, the use of lemongrass was a nice touch compared to other Vietnamese fusions that rely heavily on coriander.', "We had dinner with my wife's family In cafe Hanoi a few weeks back and it was amazing. The food was delicious, the staff was really engaging and the dining setup was impressive. The food standout for the Taste, presentation and Verity of different dishes. I would love to come back again next time while we are staying in Auckland.", 'Hanoi Cafe in the city is an excellent choice for your next date night. It’s a little more upscale than many other Vietnamese restaurants in the area, which makes the experience feel a bit more special. I was impressed with how well the venue uses its space, featuring two main dining areas and a seated bar. We had an 8:30 pm booking on a Saturday night for two, and we were promptly seated. Our server was friendly and walked us through both the food and drink menus. While it was different from what I typically expect at a Vietnamese restaurant, I was genuinely excited to try a variety of the dishes. We each ordered a cocktail. I had the Landing Dragon, which was zesty yet light. The blend of fine filtered vodka, elderflower, green tea, and vegan foam made it refreshing and unique. The other cocktail we tried was also tangy and very fresh (I can’t remember the name!). For starters, we shared the Phở Gà and the crispy rice flour and coconut milk pancake with lettuce wraps, soft herbs, and nuoc cham (with roast duck, shiitake, basil, and red chili). Though listed as starters or sharing plates, the portions were very generous and could easily be meals on their own. The Phở Gà had a warm, soothing broth with a deep chicken flavour. The pancake was a highlight. The rice flour shell was crispy, the duck was tender, and the mixture of herbs and lettuce wraps made for a fun and fresh way to eat. The nuoc cham dipping sauce added a perfect sweet, tangy balance. For mains, we had the pork belly. I was expecting it to be crispy, but the soft, slow-cooked style was still very tasty. A bit more sauce would have been nice, but it was easy enough to scoop some from the bowl. Overall, we really enjoyed our experience at Hanoi Cafe. It’s a bit busier and pricier than other Vietnamese spots, but it’s a fun and flavourful option, especially if you’re looking to elevate your usual Vietnamese dining experience.', 'Another great restaurant. If you love Vietnamese food or would like to try Vietnamese food then this is the place to go. Food was delicious. We had the set menu and were seated upstairs in a private room as it was a company function. The service was great. Nothing was a hassle and the atmosphere was good too. We had a few people with dietary requirements and that was no problems for them. The cost is above average. Highly recommend. Pic is of the delicious dessert.', "Come for take away, but let me tell you this place is luxury and crowded so prepare your clothes and make reservation! Prawn fillets with young rice battered is the star (I was surprised with the sauce - a bit thai sour and spicy flavour which brought a nice balance to the deep fried dish). Fresh paper rolls were okay. Good tight rolls with a hint of pine apple - very south Vietnam flavour. Good choice. Banh Hoi, on the other hand, was not as expected. Beef skews were bit too chewy, and not much bánh hỏi. Good side it had good fish sauce and good amount of veggies. 3 dishes for $76 - can't complain when you choose fine dining in auckland cbd, so prepare your wallet. Staffs are super nice. Crowded but they all move smoothly and fast."]
name: Cafe Hanoi
address: Tuawhiti Lane, 27 Galway Street, Britomart, Auckland 1010, New Zealand

text: ['Called in here for lunch and loved what I ordered which is their steak sandwich that comes with potato skins, it is the best steak sandwich ever! Not to mention how its cooked medium rare, it is amazing! The restaurant is spacious and clean, customer service is also excellent.', 'Thank you for an unforgettable birthday dinner! Porterhouse Grill is an unforgettable dining experience that exceeds expectations in every way. From the moment you walk in, you’re welcomed with a warm, inviting atmosphere and impeccable service that sets the stage for what’s to come. The restaurant’s elegant yet comfortable setting creates the perfect backdrop for a meal that is nothing short of spectacular. The highlight, of course, is the food. The signature Porterhouse Prime Rib steak is a true showstopper—perfectly cooked to your liking. It’s tender, juicy, and packed with flavor. Paired with expertly crafted sides, each bite is a testament to the restaurant’s commitment to excellence. The variety of other offerings, from seafood to poultry, is equally impressive, with each dish expertly prepared and beautifully presented. What truly sets Porterhouse Grill apart, however, is the attention to detail. Every aspect of the dining experience is thoughtfully curated, from the wine selection, which features a wide range of both local and international labels to the desserts that offer a perfect sweet finish to the meal. The staff is knowledgeable, attentive, and genuinely eager to ensure your experience is flawless. Whether you’re celebrating a special occasion or simply indulging in a luxurious meal, Porterhouse Grill delivers on all fronts—combining exceptional food, top-notch service, and a welcoming atmosphere to create a dining experience that is sure to leave a lasting impression. A true gem in the culinary world!', 'Visited Porterhouse Grill and tried the steak and chicken schnitzel. The steak was well-grilled and definitely the highlight of the meal—no complaints there. Unfortunately, the chicken schnitzel was overcooked and quite bland, and the sauce didn’t really complement the dish. Service was just okay—not particularly warm or attentive, but not bad either. The restaurant has a fancy feel to it, but the lighting was a bit too dim for my taste, which took away from the overall atmosphere. Price-wise, it’s reasonable for the steak, but considering the quality of the other dishes, there’s definitely room for improvement. Might come back for the steak, but would skip the schnitzel next time.', 'My scotch fillet was delicious! Mashed potato and mushroom sauce were also great - happy with the portion sizes. text: ["Service was good, drinks came out quickly, food not long after. Steak could have been a bit hotter but was perfectly cooked and tender. Didn't have space for dessert this time but we'll be back.", 'The staff were friendly but the service was slow. Husband and I made a reservation, were sat with no problems. Given menus, waited maybe 10mins after water was brought to us for a waiter. Ordered drinks and a starter (Garlic bread). Garlic bread, for the size of the loaf I expected more garlic. Bread was soft with crispy outside, was good but not enough butter and garlic. Ordered our mains, waited over 30mins. Asked about our food wait time, to be told 5mins but ended up waiting a further 15mins. I could fully understand if the restaurant was packed but the inside was practically empty. Husband ordered Lasso Hog (something like that), uh that was disappointing. It was dry and crumbled on his plate. Meat is not supposed to crumble. The portion was big but the meat was a let down. I ordered New Porker. Was supposed to be a pork belly with crispy crackle, pumpkin mash with a pine nut crumble. What I got was a pork belly with a burnt dry crackle and no nut crumble. The pine nuts were under the mash. The dish lacked flavour. There was no seasoning on the dish. The staff member we had was apologetic, he gave us complimentary chips. The one dish I did enjoy, was the salt and pepper calamari. That I would order again, the other two dishes are a no from us. We would come back to Lonestar but order something else.', 'My 10yo son and I love coming down for dinner every now and then, he always has the ribs and loves them every single time! My chicken was slightly burnt on the outside and would have loved more of the mushroom sauce but overall it was good! Our waitress was awesome, timed the food perfectly with my sons being faster than mine. Always a lovely experience, thank you ❤️', 'A go-to spot for casual birthday dinners and overdue catch ups. A nice variety of seating options from booths, to half booths + chairs and covered outdoor dining. The food here is never a let down! The best garlic loaf in the whole city and I’m quite the garlic bread connoisseur 😂 although it takes some time, the steaks are always perfectly cooked and the ribs are delicious and never skimping on portion size. Good selection of steak sauces and it’s ideal that you can always ask the waiter/waitress to swap out any sides as I’m not the biggest fries person and usually prefer a soft creamy mash with my meats. Have yet to try the desserts but have heard very good things about them! Quick tip: download the Lonestar app and make sure to collect your receipts as you pay the bill. Scan the receipt code on the app and get rewards such as credit towards your next meal.', 'Staff were very attentive, food came out very fast and it was amazing, a great selection of drinks and very easy to follow the menu at a fare market price. It has a really nice indoor outdoor flow and they played great music to match the scene of the restaurant, would definitely recommend this place.', 'The only reason I am giving a three for service is because we had a 75th birthday celebration that we told management about when we booked but they were so busy that they forgot about it. The food was delicious and we went early so did not have to wait long for it. The later it got and the busier they got, some people waited long for their food. So some advice, if you go on a Saturday evening, go early as this place is good and therefore popular. Will definitely go again.', "I came back from Australia and was excited to enjoy a nice meal at Lone Star, one of my favourite restaurants back in 2017. We were late for our 8 o’clock booking (I tried to change the time, but there was no email confirmation). When we walked in and asked for a table, they said, “Don't tell me you were the 8 o’clock booking?” and we said yes. Sophie then accused me of hanging up the phone on her. I explained that I hadn’t even received a phone call. She replied, “Well, someone hung up on me!” ??? I realised it was because I had used my Australian number (which I flagged as Australian in my booking). I told her that might have been the reason. Too which she brushed it off with no apology. Really loved the warm welcome—thank you, Sophie. The food was subpar and nowhere near the level it once was. The Dixie Chicken was served like pig slop, and that’s putting it nicely. We added extra chicken, and what appeared to be packet coleslaw with no dressing was served alongside. There were hardly any chips on the plate, and the whole thing was drowning in soup… or sauce?? Dixie Chicken used to be my go-to—this was very disappointing. The rest of the meal was mediocre. Here’s a lone star for your Lone Star.", "While the food is usually pretty good without many complaints, it always seems like they are understaffed either on the floor or in the kitchen. We got there at 12:45pm - ordered drinks about 5 minutes after arriving, then ordered our food another 5 minutes later. The starters came quickly but the mains came out at 2:05pm, not sure if what we ordered was supposed to take that long (nachos and pork) but if we had known they needed about an hour to make these, we would've gone with something simple like the burgers. Not the first time we have dealt with a very long wait time and it probably won't be the last. We also noticed many times that the wait staff were all standing together either by their station or in the kitchen having a yarn while no updates on wait time we're provided."]
name: Lone Star Albany
address: 1/270 Oteha Valley Road, Albany, Auckland 0632, New Zealand

text: ['It’s an authentic Korean restaurant where you can try Sot-bap (Korean hot stone pot rice). I’d recommend it to anyone looking for a warm, healthy meal. Good vegan/vegetarian options too. The staff are friendly, and the place is super clean!', "Delicious and amazing sotbap experience! The rice was perfectly crisp at the bottom and the ingredients were fresh. I tried the seafood sotbap and ttukbaegi bulgogi - both were absolutely delicious and packed with flavour and umami. There were a variety of side dishes that came with each menu item. A must-visit restaurant for anyone craving authentic korean food! I'll definitely be back for more. Highly recommend!!", 'Absolutely delicious and satisfying! I ordered the galbi sotbap, and it was amazing! The portion of galbi was so generous. It was super tender, and went really well with the spring onions. I also tried the grilled mackerel, and it was perfectly seasoned — not too salty, just right. The staff were friendly and overall I was really satisfied. I’ll definitely be coming back again!', 'Tried sotbap for the first time . was curious what it tasted like. It basically felt like drinking soup with soft, slightly crispy rice. Nothing really stood out for me. Maybe it’s just not my kind of dish. For the price, I felt it was a bit expensive considering what we got in terms of flavor and portion size. The side dishes were also really small. Probably wouldn’t order it again, but glad i tried it once', 'Saw review of this place and was excited to try. We got the salmon sotbap and the option one sotbap with grilled fish as a side. We also got another tteok galbi to share. The idea is ok, and the rice that you scooped into the bowl didnt taste bad with the little bit of sides they offer. The instruction to add the water into the pot and cover is not good at all. It is just tasteless rice and I see no one else in the restaurant finished theirs. The salmon was the only good thing but something that can be made easily under $30 spending close to $80 for 2 is very underwhelming. Also they need to add some black curtains to block the sun. The tables have a sun glaring straight at them... Im so angry that I had high expectations of this place.']

text: ['We had a company party there. Decent food and atmosphere. Especially loved the seasonal drink- which was Mulled Wine. It was just the way I like it.', 'We went to the Union Post for a very nice atmosphere and location. Me and my two boys all ordered the Sunday roast chicken, and the chicken was the most driest, I never knew you could make chicken so dry! And it had an awful taste like old overcooked chicken. Lucky for the Chinese takeaway next door as we were still hungry so grabbed a piece of snapper each. It turned into an incredibly expensive dinner! Usually I give 5 stars for this place but they had a shocker in the kitchen last night!', "Sunday roast here, very good. Lamb tasted good, all the roasted veges are good and the big yorkshire pudding, crisp outside, honestly cant go wrong ordering this. Cheeseburger, very average, meat was dryish and although burger was decent size, quality wasn't there for the price. Drinks were kinda pricey but overall if coming here for a social event and happen to be on a Sunday. Get the sunday roast.", 'Occasionally, you find a pub where you can just tell that the staff just really care about what they are doing. Super friendly, great atmosphere and more importantly a really good burger.', 'Excellent! This shop is impressed with attentive service, nice atmosphere, and delicious food. The appetizer and main course were standouts. Overall, it is recommended.', 'I used to be a regular here in 2003. Yup, I’m old. After almost two decades living abroad I’m again an Ellerslie local and pleased that Union Post is again a local destination for me. The service is impeccable - welcoming, friendly, professional. Good selection of tap beers, fellow patrons are amicable, and the decor is tasteful and attractive. Haven’t eaten here in 22 years but I plan to rectify that soon enough. Great place with great staff. Highly recommended.', "Had an excellent meal at Union Post last night – the food was really good. Unfortunately, the service and experience let it down. We ordered pizza and were offered a second one free as part of the night’s deal. However, it was never mentioned that the second pizza had to be eaten on the premises. When we asked for a doggy bag to take the leftovers home, we were told we couldn’t because of the two-for-one deal. Instead of being able to enjoy it the next day, we were told the pizza would be thrown away – which felt wasteful and customer-unfriendly. Service was clearly understaffed. I had to go up to the bar to order more drinks, and when our table became cluttered, I moved some empty plates and glasses to another unused table. A staff member acted like THE MATRON then came over and told me not to do this as it was “inconveniencing her,” which didn’t sit well. Overall, the food itself was great, but the service and rigid policies really affected the experience. A bit more flexibility and customer care would go a long way in encouraging people to return We did place the pizza in a normal takeaway box and was told by THE MATRON not to do this again. Weird service. We also didn't receive our 10% discount as we stayed at the La Quinta in Ellerslie and I did mention this to the server when we placed their initial beverage order"]

text: ['Tacos were poorly put together, quite average. The Calamari rings were not crispy but was soft & very oily. The Burrata cheese was solid & did not split with gooey goodness as expected esp for the price 🙈 & the pasta dish lacked flavour but looked pretty. Staff were very friendly & our meals were served quickly. The lemon, lime & bitters beverage was lovely. Access to the venue would be quite difficult for mobility impaired patrons as there are quite a few steps to go up leading to the venue.', 'Very famous spot to enjoy specifically beer, from a wide variety to choose from, and a meal too in Mission Bay. I score my beer here 100, one of the best beers I\'ve had in Auckland, pilsner was a little better than "little creatures" in terms of hops and the taste it leaves in mouth, chips besides it is very recommended, it\'s a super crispy chips well cooked. The IPA was also a super tasty beer we\'ve had. We ordered pizza as well, brisket, superb, I can score it close to "Master & Margherita" which was one of the best pizzas I\'ve had in Auckland. Well behaved staff and bringing your orders quickly even in pick hours. Pleasant country music was being played and they have live music on Fridays and Saturdays, at night I guess. Very upbeat atmosphere and lots of light during the day. If ended up in Mission Bay I recommend give this place a go.', "It is not often I do reviews but I felt the service has been so great at Good George and generally a great place that I would put pen to paper. I travel a lot and I'm sick of scanning for food and getting no personal service but this place does it old school still. If I new the blond waitress name I would call her out and it is twice we have had her service. One of the most important aspects of being a waitress is constantly subtlety checking on the table and do they want any more and happy with the food etc. Not done well by many other restaurants.", 'We had our joint 40th birthday party at Good George Mission Bay Tap Room and couldn’t be happier! Frank was great to deal with in the lead-up, and Jess the bar manager on the night was fantastic — really accommodating and made everything run smoothly. Food and drinks were excellent, and everyone had an amazing time. Highly recommend for parties and functions — we’ll definitely be back!', 'We brought a group of 50 to Mission Bay Tap Room last night, and they absolutely nailed it! text: ['We have been here before and happy to report our second visit did not disappoint! We wish we could dine here every week! text: ['Comforting food and genuinely kind service We came here for dinner with my grandma, and it turned out to be one of our favorite meals in a while. I had the chicken risotto; the chicken was perfectly cooked, incredibly tender, and full of flavor. The dish was rich and comforting, just what I was hoping for. My grandma had the lentil soup, and she said it tasted exactly like how it’s made back home in Turkey, which is a huge compliment coming from her, since she’s very picky with food. In fact, she’s been craving that same soup ever since, and we’ll definitely be back for it. A little recommendation would be to add some red chilli flakes /chilli oil for a spice kick for the soup. The staff were so friendly and welcoming. They went out of their way to make sure grandma was comfortable, even bringing her hot water (she doesn’t drink tap water), which we really appreciated. The atmosphere was also lovely warm, and relaxed. Would absolutely recommend for both the food and the heartwarming service. 💛', 'It was a nice treat finding this ambient place in the city. We had mezze lamb burger and ceviche, which are both delicious! Paired with a cocktail and beer was the good choice.', 'This place had been on my list of places to go to for a while. Finally got around to it yesterday with my wife and we absolutely loved it! My lamb burger was the best lamb I’ve ever had. So soft and flavourful, and surprisingly filling. We really enjoyed the tortillas española and my wife loved her Greek salad. The chicken on it was fantastic. I would absolutely love to come back again and would order the burger again in heart beat!', 'Outstanding desserts and great service. On a Friday evening, it was crowded and noisy, but still got a seat and got the Berry Cream cake for dessert. Outstanding like all their desserts.', "I'm sorry to say that the food quality was not worth the $80 we paid for. The Moroccan Lamb Tangine was extremely sour and gave me a tummy ache. I loved how moist the lamb was but the sauce was appalling and I gave it back to the waiter. I tried my friend's Risotto and it tasted like the flour was not cooked properly so it had a gritty floury bitter flavor. I wish that the food didn't taste so bad but unfortunately my honest review was it was not up to par."]
name: Mezze Bar
address: Durham Street East, Auckland Central, Auckland 1010, New Zealand

text: ['The view and atmosphere are gorgeous. The food is super eco friendly, the chips are milky colour, cooked by the microwave, so make sure you don’t have too much oil or fat. The top of the cake is black, super burnt, BUT upholding eco friendly standards, how could they just throw it out of the kitchen, so the customer must eat it. The waiter wrote what you ordered but never key in the system. Orrrrr the waitress can never seen anyone came or sit down. It does not matter the cafe is busy or not. Eventually an Asian lady served us, she is very kind. Others can not see me, perhaps I have super power - I am invisible.', 'Food was so delicious, they serve the most delicious fries crispy, yummy and seasoned perfectly with parmigiana cheese 🧀 on top and aioli sauce on side . Also we ordered the chocolate tart it was so delicious 🤤 but the slice is too small and pricey The staff were so friendly. We had an amazing time . The vibes were amazing , the area is stunning and the view was incredible . Highly recommended to visit with your family and friends.', "Highly recommended — and dog- and baby-approved! We had such a fantastic time at Fabrics in Hobsonville! A special shout-out to the incredible gentleman who seated us. His warm attitude and friendly accommodation set the tone for a relaxed and enjoyable visit. The ambience is just stunning — stylish yet cozy, with a great vibe that makes you want to stay longer. We paid $84 for two dishes and two drinks but the experience, service, and setting really do justify it. If you're looking for somewhere to treat yourself or take visiting friends, Fabrics is definitely worth checking out.", 'Lovely atmosphere right by the water. Great on a sunny day. Food wasn’t bad but nothing special or that stood out.', "Fabric Cafe Bistro is a fantastic spot right here in Auckland that I absolutely love, primarily for its incredible views. Seriously, you get some truly stunning scenery while you're there, making it a feast for the eyes as well as the palate! The food is pretty good too, definitely solid and satisfying, providing a decent complement to the surroundings. However, what truly makes this place shine and keeps me coming back is the overall vibe. It's perfectly set up for chilling out, having a leisurely chat, and just slowing down to enjoy the moment. Whether you're catching up with friends over coffee or simply want to unwind and take in the beautiful surroundings, Fabric Cafe Bistro nails that relaxed, unhurried atmosphere. Just a heads-up though, finding a car park around here can be a bit tricky, so it’s wise to factor that into your plans or consider public transport/rideshare. Despite the parking challenge, it’s still the ideal place to escape the city bustle and soak up some peaceful, slow-paced enjoyment, making it a highly recommended spot for anyone in Auckland looking for a scenic and relaxing cafe experience."]
name: Fabric Cafe Bistro
address: 8 Boundary Road, Hobsonville, Auckland 0616, New Zealand

text: ['We dined here on Mother’s Day. The food was amazing—especially the Pad Thai, the best I’ve ever had! When we arrived, we were given high chairs and a high table, which we weren’t told about during the reservation call—though they claimed they did. Thankfully, the Filipino bartender and Filipina service crew were incredibly helpful and arranged a better setup for us. Their service made the experience more pleasant. Great food and friendly staff, but the long wait time really needs improvement.', 'Loved the pad Thai, veggie tofu noodles and the salted fish crab rice (must try). Great atmosphere with attentive and kind staff.', 'Went there last night to celebrate my husband’s birthday. I would highly recommend this place for a date night!', 'What a great place to eat. Had not made a reservation. They happily seated us, had a toddler with us, no issue. text: ['First time at Panmure RSA tonight and we WILL be back. Such a good vibe ❤️ Meals were lovely, real value for money and the Karaoke entertainment was next level. Awesome AWESOME singers. Highly recommend this venue for a great night out ❤️', "Below is an update on my previous review now I have amended my review as it feels things have gotten even worse so I have changed my previous review from 3 stars to 1. After a long break from coming here due to issues such as the RSA being closed when it should be open, poor communication and unpredictability of beer and food availability me and my friend decided to come in to collect our cards and see if things had improved and see if itwould be worth renewing our membership. Unfortunately when I arrived a rude (possibly slightly inebriated) lady called Margarette refused me and my friend entry because we were wearing shirts with no collar, she said she was the secretary and makes the rules. I have come on numerous occasions in similar attire and both me and my friend's have never been told of this, I recall numerous others wearing similar attire, even their photos on Facebook show people who won raffles collecting their prizes in far less formal T-shirts than we were wearing. There is no sign at the RSA or rules on the website stating any issue with this type of attire. Our t-shirts were clean and of nice dress and have never been an issue at other restaurants or even at Sky City. What's the point of being a member if when they do decide to actually open they won't even let their members in. After this experience I am seriously reconsidering continuing my membership after this experience.", 'It was a while back, but cannot forget the hospitality both the bar staff and the veterans there gave us outsiders. The layout is also nice and big, with dart boards and pool tables I think I remember. Tables had really cool fishing and other gear inlaid under the resin coating. Get your Lion Reds here haha.', "The lady staff who opens the shop on Thursdays has a really bad attitude problem.Doesn't have any respect for the customers at all.", 'It may be small but the atmosphere is great. The staff and members are friendly. Love the food. Really enjoy Friday night karaoke.']
